resources.string: For independent rear displays on Android 17. Both features are off by default. Include System Framework and System features plug-in in the module scope, then restart after changing either feature switch to apply changes. The top-right button restarts the entire device.
Also show an Alipay code on the rear display
Set the system power double press action to Transit / Mi Pay / Access cards. Enable to choose the rear display code while keeping the wallet on the main display, after unlocking when required.

Add Alipay payment code (rear display) and Alipay transit code (rear display) to the system double and triple back tap lists. The ordinary payment code still uses the main display. Select another system action before turning this feature off.
